text:
incident-bot: PAGED — billing-alerts: multiple overage flags detected for ~12 accounts (low volume customers). See alert: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/ALRT-8721 :rotating_light:
oncall-ecs: I'm oncall. pulling emitter + collector logs now.
sam: seeing sudden token spikes from collector-shard-7 starting 02:12Z, counts jump ~+10k tokens/min vs baseline.
maya: confirmed, also a small batch of delayed windows re-emitted — looks like duplicate flushes.
billing-sre: which pipeline? emitter -> kafka -> collector-agg -> billing-proxy? recent deploys?
oncall-ecs: yes that path. Deployed emitter v2 ~01:58Z (tweak: batch_flush_ms 200->2000). suspect batching change increased retries on intermittent producer timeouts causing duplicates.
sam: logs show producer retries followed by a successful re-send with same payload id but collector accepted both. example log: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-20T02:12:07Z","shard":"7","payload_id":"pfx_9a3","tokens":4800,"producer_retries":3}
```
maya: collector isn't validating payload_id uniqueness for that shard due to recent sharding-resync change. KV dedupe key missing for resharded partitions.
ops-lead: that matches a change in collector reshard code rolled 01:50Z. Rolling back?
oncall-ecs: recommend immediate mitigation: pause emitter v2 rollout, flip collector to dedupe-mode=true, and throttle replays.
billing-sre: customers already received overage emails? which accounts impacted?
support-lead: support queue has 9 threads opened, some customers reported unexpected spikes. We should suppress automated overage emails while we investigate.
ops-lead: action: pause emitter v2 rollout — @sam can you trigger rollback?
sam: rolling back emitter v2 now — invoking canary abort. ```bash
./deploy cancel --service=usage-emitter --tag=v2 --env=prod
```
ops-lead: confirmed rollback started.
oncall-ecs: toggled collector.dedupe_mode = true in prod via feature-flag (ff-collector-dedupe). Propagating to all replicas.
maya: verifying dedupe; replays still in buffer but should be dropped now. Running a quick query for duplicate payload_ids in window: ```sql
SELECT payload_id, count(*) FROM collector_events WHERE window='2026-03-20T02:00' GROUP BY payload_id HAVING count(*)>1 LIMIT 10;
```
sam: initial check: 54 dup payload_ids across 8 customers, totals ~24k tokens double-counted.
billing-sre: estimate customer-visible overcount = ~18k tokens across flagged accounts. We'll need to retract overage flags and re-run billing delta.
support-lead: suppressing overage emails via admin-ui now. patch: turned off template-sender for billing-overage.
ops-lead: set short-term mitigation: (1) rollback emitter, (2) enable dedupe, (3) pause overage notifications, (4) start one-off backfill job to recompute usage for affected windows.
oncall-ecs: backfill job queued with dedupe=true, job id bf-5650. ETA ~30m. Monitoring logs: consumer lag stabilized.
sam: command to inspect current lag: ```bash
kc consumer-lag usage-events --group collector-consumers | grep shard-7
# shows lag 120 -> 8 after rollback
```
maya: started backfill with dedupe and idempotency checks. sample output: ```json
{"job":"bf-5650","status":"running","affected_customers":12,"expected_runtime_min":28}
```
billing-sre: I'll run billing re-consolidation once backfill finishes. Hold for final counts before re-issuing invoices.
support-lead: prepping customer comms: draft message to affected customers explaining transient duplicate counting due to emitter rollout, offering credits. Will wait for final numbers.
ops-lead: timeline summary: deploy change at 01:58Z -> shard resync bug allowed duplicates -> alerts at 02:12Z -> rollback + dedupe flip 02:19Z -> backfill started 02:22Z.
oncall-ecs: tagging postmortem owners: @sam (emitter), @maya (collector), @billing-sre (billing recon), @support-lead (customer comms).
sam: logging root cause: batch_flush_ms increase + sharding resync missing dedupe-index. Will prepare PR with stronger payload_id enforcement and e2e test.
maya: will revert sharding-resync patch and add dedupe-key invariant checks in collector.
billing-sre: will produce final reconciliation run and confirm no customers billed incorrectly.
support-lead: will send comms after billing confirms. Suggested temporary credit for impacted customers: full overage amount for this window.
oncall-ecs: all services stable. monitoring will alert if duplicate rate >0 for next 1h.
support-lead: confirmed, opening support case templates and tagging affected accounts. I'll post follow-up when backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
